pages.title: Feed and purpose
pages.text: The Reprocessor reclaims resources from silicon slag, contaminated products, logic gates, and wafers. Supply power; a cleanroom is not required.$(br2)Check JEI for the materials and quantities recovered from each input.

pages.title: Recovery
pages.text: Insert the feed and provide space for every output. Return recovered materials to the manufacturing line.$(br2)Both unfinished and completed wafers can be reprocessed. Set aside any circuit designs you intend to keep before loading the machine.
